name: Stresa (Italy)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Stresa (a red cross on white above blue waves, crowned, within branches).
history: Municipal flag of Stresa, a comune in Piedmont; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Stresa arms — a red cross on white above blue waves, crowned, within branches
